title: PolyDiff Deeplink-Family Fact Vector
description: Per-implementation fact vector for the deeplink family. Sibling of fact-vector.schema.json (URL family), fact-vector-image.schema.json (image family), and fact-vector-opengraph.schema.json (opengraph family); all share input_id + parser_profile as the cross-family identity keys that the diff engine pairs vectors on. Axes follow the T-M2.4 spec: scheme, host, path, query_params, fragment_action, declared_permissions, intent_action, intent_category, parser_warnings, decode_outcome. When a wrapper binary/package is absent (e.g. the Android or iOS toolchain is not installed in the devcontainer) the wrapper emits a crash envelope with binary_missing=true and decode_outcome.status='parse_error'; that envelope still validates so the missing parser stays auditable in the diff report.

binary_missing.description: Set by the wrapper when the underlying parser binary/toolchain is not available. The deeplink axes are then null/empty and decode_outcome.status MUST be 'parse_error'.

scheme.description: URI scheme parsed from input (http, https, sgnl, signal, intent, etc.). Empty string permitted for parse_error / binary_missing envelopes.

host.description: Authority host component (e.g. 'example.com'). null when absent (opaque scheme) or unparseable.

path.description: Path component (e.g. '/chat/abc'). null when absent or unparseable. Traversal characters ('../') are reported as-parsed; the triage classifier flags path divergence regardless of content.

query_params.description: Parsed query parameters as key-value map. null when no query string is present. Multi-valued keys are reported as their first occurrence (per WHATWG-URL); divergence in handling of duplicates surfaces here.

fragment_action.description: Fragment-encoded action (e.g. '#openLink'). For intent:// URIs this may carry the encoded Intent extras (e.g. 'Intent;action=android.intent.action.VIEW;end'). null when no fragment is present.

declared_permissions.description: For Android intent URIs, the permissions declared in the intent. Empty array when none are declared. Divergence in this axis surfaces Android implicit-export risk.

intent_action.description: For 'intent://' schemes, the Intent action component (e.g. 'android.intent.action.VIEW'). null for non-intent schemes.

intent_category.description: Intent categories (e.g. 'android.intent.category.BROWSABLE'). null for non-intent schemes; empty array when intent declares none.

parser_warnings.description: Implementation-emitted warnings (e.g. 'unknown scheme', 'malformed query string', 'path traversal segment'). Empty array on a clean parse.

decode_outcome.description: Implementation-reported parse outcome. 'parse_error' covers parser crash, FileNotFoundError (toolchain missing), and other catastrophic failures; 'scheme_unknown' is the parser cleanly recognizing a scheme outside its known set; 'malformed' is a known scheme with bad syntax; 'ok' is a clean parse.
